Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and AndroidX. Material source attribution is available in Material Curves → Details.

This app estimates highline webbing deformation and loads using simplified mechanical models, nonlinear material force–elongation relationships and energy conservation. Predictions depend on the selected materials, rig configuration and model assumptions.
The solver has not been experimentally validated. Real mainline failures involve dynamic processes not fully captured by the model. Material force–elongation curves may contain extrapolated regions.
Simple Mode uses fixed material coordinates: no webbing sliding is solved. Friction, connections and other effects may be simplified or omitted. Dynamics is not implemented.

Calculated maximum sag and forces are theoretical predictions, not guaranteed physical bounds. The tool is not a substitute for appropriate rigging knowledge, engineering judgment or established safety practices.

Are you a webbing or bungee manufacturer with experimentally measured force–elongation curves?\n\nContributions of verified material data to improve the solver are welcome. Please contact the developer.
